official: 国立市後期高齢者医療に関する条例の一部を改正する条例案

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 議案
令和8年第1回定例会 会議結果報告

name: 公示送達に電子画面を使えるように
summary: 現在、後期高齢者医療に関する公示送達は、書面を掲示して行うことになっています。この議案では、公示事項を不特定多数の人が閲覧できる状態にしたうえで、市の事務所にある電子計算機の画面で閲覧できるようにする方法も選べるようにします。改正後の規定は、条例の施行日以後に行う公示送達に適用します。
changes: 公示事項を不特定多数の人が閲覧できる状態にする措置を定める
公示送達を、書面の掲示または市の事務所の電子計算機画面で閲覧できる方法で行えるようにする
who: 後期高齢者医療に関する公示送達を受ける人
why: 地方税法の一部改正に伴い、公示送達の方法を定め直すためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Allow service by public notice through electronic screens
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Kunitachi City Ordinance Concerning Medical Care for Older Senior Citizens
en.summary: Currently, service by public notice concerning medical care for older senior citizens is carried out by posting a written notice. This bill would also allow a method in which the matters to be made public are made accessible to an unspecified number of people and can be viewed on a computer screen at a city office. The amended provisions would apply to service by public notice carried out on or after the ordinance’s effective date.
changes: Specify measures for making the matters to be made public accessible to an unspecified number of people
Allow service by public notice to be carried out either by posting a written notice or by making the notice viewable on a computer screen at a city office
who: People who receive service by public notice concerning medical care for older senior citizens
en.why: The city says this is to establish the method of service by public notice again following a partial amendment to the Local Tax Act.
